resources.string: Open your banking or UPI app now. When you\'re done, tap the Shorts Blocker tile in Quick Settings (or the notification) to turn protection back on.

Many banking and UPI apps refuse to open while any accessibility service is on. That is a security feature, and Shorts Blocker does not try to hide from it.\n\nBefore opening one, pull down Quick Settings and tap the Shorts Blocker tile to pause protection. When you\'re done, tap the tile (or the notification) to turn it back on.
Open Quick Settings, tap the edit (pencil) icon and drag the Shorts Blocker tile into your tiles.
Tap to turn protection back on when you\'re done
Adds a 30-second wait and a typed phrase before you can switch a blocker off
Strict mode is on. To continue, wait %2$d seconds and type:\n\n%1$s
